day_shape: 65 items: US Treasury sanctions eight crypto firms over Iran rial exchanges, Trump confirms US strike on Qeshm Island anti-aircraft system, State Dept/CENTCOM post $20m reward for Iran nuclear-programme tips, heavy IRGC Aerospace Week messaging from Defa Press, Khamenei channel confirms Rezaei's Putin visit.

threads.label: US Treasury crypto sanctions on Iran networks
threads.summary: The State Department announced Treasury designations against eight digital asset service providers accused of exchanging Iranian rials for crypto to evade sanctions, coordinated with Canada. Jerusalem Post reported the action also barred crypto exchange MEXC Global from the US financial system and targeted eight Canadian-based money services businesses.

threads.label: Qeshm Island strike confirmed
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported two missiles struck Qeshm Island in southern Iran per Tasnim, and that Trump later confirmed a US strike destroyed an anti-aircraft system there as Qatar continued mediation. Iran International reported a US military official urged Iranian civilians to stay away from IRGC positions if tensions escalate.

threads.label: $20m reward for Iran nuclear intelligence
threads.summary: CENTCOM and the Jerusalem Post publicised a State Department Rewards for Justice offer of up to $20 million and possible relocation for information on Iran's nuclear programme — facilities, equipment and personnel. Iran International separately reported BBC Verify satellite imagery showing construction near missile bases and repairs to installations damaged by US and Israeli strikes.

threads.label: IRGC Aerospace Week press conference
threads.summary: Defa Press ran a live stream of IRGC spokesman Commander Mohebby claiming Iranian missiles penetrated enemy air defences, that seven enemy reconnaissance drones were brought down via electronic warfare, and that Iran had moved from importer to exporter of aerospace weapons. Equipment displays were said to be staged in venues nationwide during Aerospace Week.

threads.label: Iran-Russia outreach: S-400s, gas, Putin letter
threads.summary: Iran International, citing The Telegraph, reported Iran sent security chief Mohsen Rezaei to Moscow with a personal letter from Khamenei to Putin requesting S-400 air defences, and separately that Tehran is turning to Russia for natural gas supplies ahead of winter. Khamenei's office confirmed via Ali Bagheri that the SNSC secretary met Putin for around three hours to deliver the leader's message.

threads.label: Regime narrative on US midterms and Hormuz
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press framed Republican US election losses as the outcome of Iran's Strait of Hormuz blockade, with commentators calling Iran a 'superpower' and citing Joe Kent on Gulf states accepting Iranian regional dominance. Iran International reported Tehran celebrating US economic pain while Iranians face a cost-of-living crisis, and noted divided Iranian reactions to JD Vance's remarks on war costs.

threads.label: Pahlavi events and Iran threats to Europe
threads.summary: Iran International reported exiled prince Reza Pahlavi accepted Germany's Freedom Prize on behalf of the Iranian people in Frankfurt with tens of thousands rallying, and separately that Belgium's defence minister said Tehran had warned of consequences if Pahlavi's Brussels speech went ahead. Jerusalem Post reported a Greek man charged in London with assisting a foreign intelligence service, said by police to be acting for Iran, pleaded not guilty.

events.title_en: Any attack on Iran will be met with an immediate, unlimited and destructive response
events.summary_en: Any attack on Iran will be met with an immediate, unlimited and destructive response. A senior security official, noting the continuation of military threats from the enemy, said: America and the Zionist regime constantly repeat their threats aimed at exerting psychological pressure on Iran's people; but they must know that these threats will have no effect on Iran's determination to mount a decisive response to any aggression. Any strike against Iran will be permission for an immediate, unlimited and regrettable response, and Iran will observe no geographical, temporal or target list limitations in defence of itself. We do not recognise any concept of limited or short-term attack, and the response to any transgression will be unlimited and trans-regional.

events.title_en: Following publication of incomplete news regarding abolition of ration cards: the figure indicates an increase in ration cards, not their abolition
events.summary_en: Following publication of incomplete news regarding abolition of ration cards: the figure indicates an increase in ration cards, not their abolition. Some news agencies, by publishing incomplete news, claimed the abolition of ration cards for households with incomes of 20 and 27 million tomans. Whereas the figures announced indicate an increase in ration cards from one million to one million five hundred thousand tomans for lower-income deciles, not a measure for abolishing the entire ration card amount. According to the deputy for welfare of the Ministry of Cooperatives, Labour and Social Welfare, the indices for abolishing ration cards are at minimum several times the figures released in cyberspace, which will be informed in the coming days.

events.title_en: Why is prayer sometimes delayed in being answered? There are three types of prayers we make: one type is not answered at all, and two types are answered. One type is answered in this world, some are not answered here but are answered in the hereafter. Often, out of grace towards people, their prayers are not answered on this side but are saved for the other side. Therefore, in narrations it is mentioned that people say if only none of our prayers had been answered in this world; if all our prayers had been answered here. The collection 'Manner of Servitude' contains spiritual and moral points drawn from the teachings of Ayatollah Syed Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei, which will be published progressively by the media office of the Supreme Leader of the Revolution

events.title_en: Ali Bagheri: Elements of relations between the two countries in the new era were raised in the leader's message to Putin
events.summary_en: Deputy Secretary of the Supreme National Security Council: The Secretary of the Supreme National Security Council had a detailed meeting with Mr Putin, President of the Russian Federation, which lasted around 3 hours. The main purpose of this visit was to present the leader's message to the President of Russia. In this message, both the elements envisioned by the Islamic Republic of Iran for bilateral cooperation were raised and the prospects for these cooperations and interactions were outlined, so that for the Russians, the issue of cooperation with the Islamic Republic of Iran in the era of leadership of Ayatollah Seyyed Mostafa Khamenei would become clearer.

events.title: Iran threatened Belgium over Pahlavi’s Brussels speech, defense minister says
events.summary: Belgium’s defense minister said on Friday that Tehran had warned his country of dire consequences if it allowed Reza Pahlavi, Iran’s exiled prince, to speak in Brussels, and that the event had gone ahead anyway.
